notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis (fund balances printed, no cash roll-forward); business-type funds are accrual. beginning/ending_fund_balance = Total Governmental Funds fund balances 2,648,301 / 2,677,257 (p5); cash fields null as in FY2024/FY2025 (no total governmental cash printed). Statement of Activities TIF proceeds 72,192 vs funds statement 97,507 are on different bases (not a discrepancy).
